title: mail-server: Email/set compose invalidProperties lacks properties
description: Split from JMAP-3xlt. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs compose_email map_err fallback arm (`_ => json!({"type":"invalidProperties","description":...})`) returns no properties array (RFC 8620 §5.3 SHOULD). Not a serde typed parse, so the JMAP-ub41 serde_path_to_error pattern does not apply. Reachable variants: ComposeError::EmptyPart (body part with no partId/blobId/subParts; carries no indication of which of textBody/htmlBody/attachments/bodyStructure holds it) and ComposeError::Write(WriteError::LineBreak|InvalidFieldName) which carry an RFC 5322 field name (e.g. To, Message-ID, Content-Type), not a JMAP property. BlobNotFound and MissingBodyValue are pre-empted by the blob pre-check and validate_body_part. Same function: validate_email_body errors (email.rs ~1874) also return invalidProperties without properties. DECISION NEEDED: (a) pre-check EmptyPart in validate_body_part and make validate_email_body return the top-level property (textBody/htmlBody/attachments/bodyStructure/header:*) it failed on, and map Write field names via a fixed table (From->from, Sender->sender, Reply-To->replyTo, To/Cc/Bcc, Subject->subject, Date->sentAt, Message-ID->messageId, In-Reply-To->inReplyTo, References->references, else the matching top-level header: key, else the body properties present); (b) only fix validate_email_body + EmptyPart pre-check and leave Write errors description-only (header line-break injection is rare); (c) leave as is (SHOULD). Recommendation: (b) - constraint over mechanism; no field-name mapping table.
notes:
DECISION Mark 2026-10-30: option (b). Pre-check EmptyPart in validate_body_part and make validate_email_body name the top-level property it failed on (textBody/htmlBody/attachments/bodyStructure/header:*); leave ComposeError::Write errors description-only. No header-name mapping table.
